[EN] The Search for Truth
[ES] La búsqueda de la verdad
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "Got it."
[ES] "Entendido."
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "Let me handle this."
[ES] "Déjame encargarme de esto."
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Ask Marat about archdeva activities.
[ES] Preguntar a Marat sobre las actividades de los archdevas.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "I'm no one...and I was just leaving."
[ES] "No soy nadie... y ya me iba."
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Find the cave and use the truth needle on {@LinkCreature:181#2008}.
[ES] Encuentra la cueva y usa la aguja de la verdad en {@LinkCreature:181#2008}.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Find Shifting Map in Camp Commander's Chest.
[ES] Encuentra el mapa móvil en el cofre del comandante del campamento.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "Shh. I will. Don't worry."
[ES] "Shh. Lo haré. No te preocupes."
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Speak to the Exhausted Prisoner.
[ES] Habla con el prisionero agotado.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Climb the ladder and destroy the wooden cage.
[ES] Sube por la escalera y destruye la jaula de madera.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "I'll draw them off. When I do—run!"
[ES] "Los distraeré. Cuando lo haga... ¡corre!"
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Release Enslaved Khirian Archer.
[ES] Libera al arquero khirian esclavizado.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "Plenty of time for that later. I've got this."
[ES] "Habrá tiempo de sobra para eso después. Yo me encargo."
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Release Enslaved Khirian Warrior.
[ES] Libera al guerrero khirian esclavizado.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "You might be right. One way to find out."
[ES] "Tal vez tengas razón. Solo hay una forma de averiguarlo."
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Go to Baaldaz Post and report to Dougal.
[ES] Ve al puesto Baaldaz e infórmale a Dougal.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026
